# Stress Fixtures

Generated by:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate-stress-fixtures.py
```

Fixture categories:

- `vector_pid_package_32.pdf`: 32-page vector P&ID package with off-page continuations, legend sheet content, dense tags, and repeated line IDs.
- `cable_continuation_package.pdf`: 8-page cable/conduit package with dashed routing and continuation callouts.
- `raster_scanned_pid_package.pdf` plus `raster_scanned_pid_*.png`: scanned-style raster stress sheets with skew, speckle, folds, low contrast, and exact programmatically rendered labels.

`manifest.json` contains expected tags, line IDs, cable IDs, and continuation labels.

To run the stress pack through the live backend API:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=backend python3 -m recreation_extractor.cli serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --data-dir .recreation-data
python3 scripts/stress-api-smoke.py
```
